description: Capability for embedded Blue Web content webviews (arbitrary external pages, label pattern web-*) — grants ONLY the scoped title/favicon report command, none of what the main shell webview (see default.json) can do. See BlueWebApp/mod.rs's module doc for the full reasoning and one real open caveat (Tauri child-webview capability scoping has a history of bugs; verify against this project's actual pinned Tauri version before treating this as a hard boundary).
